boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Messiah University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with currently published late hours in Mechanicsburg or on Messiah’s campus.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Carlisle Pike
cards.subtitle: 6520 Carlisle Pike, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a post-evening food stop; the official location page lists service until 1 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Mechanicsburg drive-thru listed open through 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–1 a.m. daily at 6520 Carlisle Pike.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 9 a.m.–1 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell at Gettysburg Pike
cards.subtitle: 151 Gettysburg Pike, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: Plan for a drive-thru pickup rather than dine-in after 10 p.m.; the official listing shows the drive-thru running until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Gettysburg Pike drive-thru with midnight hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–12 a.m. daily at 151 Gettysburg Pike.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 9 a.m.–12 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Carlisle Pike
cards.subtitle: 6101 Carlisle Pike, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: Keep this Carlisle Pike restaurant in mind for a late meal; its official page lists both restaurant and drive-thru service through midnight.
cards.short_summary: Restaurant and drive-thru hours extend to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–12 a.m. daily at 6101 Carlisle Pike.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are each listed 10 a.m.–12 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Wendy’s at Cumberland Parkway
cards.subtitle: 305 Cumberland Parkway, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: Choose this Cumberland Parkway location when a seated or drive-thru food option is useful; both are listed until midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A Cumberland Parkway location with midnight restaurant hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–12 a.m. daily at 305 Cumberland Parkway.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are each listed 10 a.m.–12 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Sheetz at 6054 Carlisle Pike
cards.subtitle: 6054 Carlisle Pike, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: Use this convenience-store stop for food or packaged snacks at any hour; the store locator identifies this as the Mechanicsburg store page.
cards.short_summary: A Carlisle Pike convenience stop for round-the-clock access.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz’s official store locator provides a dedicated listing for its 6054 Carlisle Pike Mechanicsburg location.
cards.access_notes: Official locator identifies the store; verify made-to-order counter availability during overnight visits.

cards.title: Sheetz at 6558 Carlisle Pike
cards.subtitle: 6558 Carlisle Pike, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: Use the named Carlisle Pike store for a round-the-clock convenience stop; check the official store page for current food-service details before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A second Carlisle Pike option for overnight convenience purchases.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz’s official store locator provides a dedicated listing for its 6558 Carlisle Pike Mechanicsburg location.
cards.access_notes: Official locator identifies the store; verify made-to-order counter availability during overnight visits.

cards.title: Sheetz on South Market Street
cards.subtitle: 1415 South Market Street, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: For a south-side Mechanicsburg stop, use this named store for convenience items and consult its official locator listing before an overnight trip.
cards.short_summary: A South Market Street convenience-store destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz’s official store locator provides a dedicated listing for its 1415 South Market Street Mechanicsburg location.
cards.access_notes: Official locator identifies the store; verify made-to-order counter availability during overnight visits.

cards.title: Denny’s on Carlisle Pike
cards.subtitle: 5505 Carlisle Pike, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official daily schedule when planning a later sit-down or takeout meal; it lists midnight closing on most weekdays.
cards.short_summary: A Carlisle Pike diner with midnight weekday closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists 5 a.m.–12 a.m. hours Monday–Friday and 24-hour service Saturday and Sunday at 5505 Carlisle Pike.
cards.access_notes: Listed until 12 a.m. Monday–Friday and open 24 hours Saturday and Sunday.

cards.title: Spice Restaurant and Bar
cards.subtitle: 125 West Main Street, Mechanicsburg
cards.notes: Order dine-in or take-away food from this downtown location on an eligible evening; its own site posts service until 11 p.m. and Tuesday closure.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Mechanicsburg kitchen listed open through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Spice Restaurant and Bar lists dine-in or take-away hours of 2–11 p.m. Monday and Wednesday–Sunday, and says it is closed Tuesday.
cards.access_notes: Listed 2–11 p.m. Monday and Wednesday–Sunday; closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Union Café in Larsen Student Union
cards.subtitle: Larsen Student Union, Messiah University
cards.notes: Stay on campus for a food stop during the school year; Messiah’s dining page lists the Union Café open until 10 p.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus café with 10 p.m. school-year hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah University lists Union Café school-year hours until 10 p.m. Monday–Friday and Saturday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Messiah University Dining Services — Menus, Locations & Hours
cards.access_notes: School-year hours are listed until 10 p.m. daily; the page states the café is closed for summer.
